checked_by: Antigravity, reading every stated fact directly from reviewToolkit outputs on the live GCS trace (match_overview, death_context, build_check, lane_report, pro_item_choices, key_moments).
source: Live GCS trace with parsed OpenDota match record. A 25:27 Radiant carry loss from the lanes (-3,812 at 10:00, never closer than -4,121 after): 11 deaths total (most on team), 9 outside fights, 10 not traded, 4 while farming, 87% enemy spell damage, Battle Fury only (no BKB).

must_hit.says: Lost bot lane badly (3,218 vs 6,496 at 10:00; three deaths before 10:00 at 5:04, 7:08 and 9:44, none traded).

Nine of the eleven deaths were outside fights and ten of eleven were not traded within 15 s; four began while farming (15:05, 16:48, 21:25, 23:03) and four had no ally within 2200 (5:04, 11:29, 21:25, 24:02).
87% of death-window damage came from enemy abilities and items (Sand King 49%, 4 kills; Death Prophet 4 kills), while only Battle Fury (12:24) was finished and no Black King Bar was built.

must_not.says: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace is a passive ultimate: a review must never claim it had 0 casts or was left ready and uncast.

story_cause.says: Radiant was 3,812 gold behind at 10:00 and never closer than -4,121 after (match_overview.lanes.lost_from_the_lanes true; no turning fight).
